description: SPEC v2.3 §15.4 scenarios, written and hand-computed by D (no engine code); 23-28 and the new answers for 5 and 22 come from the v2.3 advice-correctness fixes. Each cart is a §15.5 Cart plus screenType. Cash is Decimal, each card rounded to cents half-up before subtracting (§7.2 rule 1). recommendedCardId is the baseline card for keep (the card selected on screen when its network names exactly one wallet card, else the default; §7.2) and null for no_checkout. cashDeltaVsCashBest and cashDeltaVsDefault are the recommended (or kept) card's cash minus the cash-best card's and the default's. protectionsGained lists the types the recommended card has that the baseline lacks, so it is [] for every keep. screenshot names the fixtures/carts and fixtures/ocr file the cart comes from, or null for a synthetic cart.

scenarios.title: S1: laptop $1,499, saved card
scenarios.workings: Rule 0: checkout. Rule 1: no Apple Pay button, so path saved_card and card rates. apple-card 1% x 1499.00 = 14.99; wf-active-cash 2% x 1499.00 = 29.98; chase-freedom-unlimited 1.5% x 1499.00 = 22.485 -> 22.49 (half-up). cashBest = wf-active-cash (29.98). Rule 2: items readable (0.92 >= 0.8). Rule 3: laptop is new, not a gift card or service plan, computers is warrantyRelevant and theftDamageRelevant, 1499.00 >= 100, so it qualifies; FU has purchase_protection + extended_warranty (paymentRequirement some_portion, met); apple-card has none; wf-active-cash only cell_phone_protection (not counted). Rule 4 (P): FU adds both types the default lacks and drops none -> switch / protection -> FU. deltaVsCashBest = 22.49 - 29.98 = -7.49; deltaVsDefault = 22.49 - 14.99 = +7.50 (matches §6.3).

scenarios.title: S1-R: renewed laptop $1,099, no warranty
scenarios.workings: Rule 1 (saved_card): apple-card 1% x 1099.00 = 10.99; wf-active-cash 2% x 1099.00 = 21.98; FU 1.5% x 1099.00 = 16.485 -> 16.49. cashBest = wf-active-cash. Rule 2: readable. Rule 3: condition renewed is not in conditionsAllowed ['new'], so no card has an eligible protection. Rule 4 (P): nothing to gain. Rule 5 (G): default has nothing to lose. Rule 6 (C): cashBest != default, gain 21.98 - 10.99 = 10.99 >= 5 (saved_card) -> switch / cash -> AC. deltaVsCashBest = 21.98 - 21.98 = 0.00; deltaVsDefault = +10.99 (the spec's '+$10.99 vs Apple Card'). Eligibility note per §6.3 / §7.3 (v2.3 wording: the engine can't see whether the listing has a warranty).

scenarios.title: Earbuds $249 (audio), saved card
scenarios.workings: Rule 1 (saved_card): apple-card 1% x 249.00 = 2.49; wf-active-cash 2% x 249.00 = 4.98; FU 1.5% x 249.00 = 3.735 -> 3.74 (half-up, before subtracting). cashBest = wf-active-cash. Rule 3: audio is relevant to both types, 249.00 >= 100, new -> qualifies; FU has PP + EW. Rule 4 (P): FU adds both, drops none -> switch / protection -> FU. deltaVsCashBest = 3.74 - 4.98 = -1.24; deltaVsDefault = 3.74 - 2.49 = +1.25. (Rounding after subtracting would give -1.245 -> -1.25: the spec's -1.24 needs round-first.)

scenarios.title: Mug $18 (home), saved card
scenarios.workings: Rule 1 (saved_card): apple-card 1% x 18.00 = 0.18; wf-active-cash 2% x 18.00 = 0.36; FU 1.5% x 18.00 = 0.27. cashBest = wf-active-cash. Rule 3: home is neither warrantyRelevant nor theftDamageRelevant and 18.00 < 100 -> no qualifying item. Rules 4-5: nothing. Rule 6 (C): gain 0.36 - 0.18 = 0.18 < 5 -> no switch. Rule 7 (M): no Apple Pay button. Rule 8: default protects nothing; cashBest != default -> keep / below_threshold. Kept card = default apple-card: deltaVsCashBest = 0.18 - 0.36 = -0.18; deltaVsDefault = 0.00.

scenarios.title: S1-K: laptop $1,499, Freedom default, Mastercard (Apple Card) selected
scenarios.workings: Baseline (v2.3): the screen selects a saved Mastercard, and apple-card is the only Mastercard in fu-default, so the baseline is apple-card, not the default. Rule 1 (saved_card): FU 1.5% x 1499.00 = 22.485 -> 22.49; wf-active-cash 29.98; apple-card 14.99. cashBest = wf-active-cash. Rule 3: laptop qualifies; FU has PP + EW eligible; apple-card has none. Rule 4 (P): FU adds both types the baseline lacks and drops none -> switch / protection -> FU ('Change card to Visa ••1234'). deltaVsCashBest = 22.49 - 29.98 = -7.49; deltaVsDefault = 0.00 (FU is the default). Before v2.3 this was keep / already_protected: 'Keep Freedom' while Apple Card was selected (product review, Oct 17). Scenario 23 keeps the guard case.

scenarios.title: Laptop $1,499, no protection cards (tie)
scenarios.workings: Rule 1 (saved_card): apple-card 1% x 1499.00 = 14.99; discover 1% x 1499.00 = 14.99. Tie -> cashBest = the default, apple-card. Rule 3: laptop qualifies but neither card has PP or EW. Rules 4-5: nothing. Rule 6: cashBest == default. Rule 7: no Apple Pay button. Rule 8: cashBest == default -> keep / default_best. Deltas 0.00 / 0.00.

scenarios.title: Laptop $1,499, Apple Card + Active Cash
scenarios.workings: Rule 1 (saved_card): apple-card 14.99; wf-active-cash 2% x 1499.00 = 29.98. cashBest = wf-active-cash. Rule 3: laptop qualifies but neither card has PP or EW (Active Cash: cell phone only). Rules 4-5: nothing. Rule 6 (C): gain 29.98 - 14.99 = 14.99 >= 5 -> switch / cash -> AC. deltaVsCashBest = 0.00; deltaVsDefault = +14.99.

scenarios.title: S2: Nike $180 shoes, Apple Pay visible
scenarios.workings: Rule 1: Apple Pay button visible -> path apple_pay. apple-card: merchant rule nike + apple_pay 3% beats the 2% Apple Pay rule (merchant > category > base) -> 3% x 180.00 = 5.40; wf-active-cash 2% = 3.60; FU 1.5% = 2.70. cashBest = apple-card = default. Rule 3: apparel not relevant -> no qualifying item. Rules 4-6: nothing (cashBest == default). Rule 7 (M): default earns more via Apple Pay (5.40) than typed (1% = 1.80) and the button is visible -> keep / method ('3% ($5.40) with Apple Pay vs 1% typed'). Deltas 0.00 / 0.00.

scenarios.title: Nike $180 shoes, card form only
scenarios.workings: Rule 1: no Apple Pay button -> path card_form. apple-card: the nike and Apple Pay rules need apple_pay, so base 1% x 180.00 = 1.80; wf-active-cash 3.60; FU 2.70. cashBest = wf-active-cash. Rule 3: apparel -> nothing qualifies. Rule 6 (C): gain 3.60 - 1.80 = 1.80 < 5 -> no switch. Rule 7: no Apple Pay button. Rule 8 -> keep / below_threshold. The spec's '$1.80' is that gain; kept default vs cashBest = 1.80 - 3.60 = -1.80; deltaVsDefault = 0.00.

scenarios.title: Headphones $120 (audio)
scenarios.workings: Rule 1 (saved_card): apple-card 1% x 120.00 = 1.20; wf-active-cash 2.40; FU 1.5% x 120.00 = 1.80. cashBest = wf-active-cash. Rule 3: audio, 120.00 >= 100, new -> qualifies; FU has PP + EW. Rule 4 (P) -> switch / protection -> FU. deltaVsCashBest = 1.80 - 2.40 = -0.60; deltaVsDefault = 1.80 - 1.20 = +0.60.

scenarios.title: Headphones $90 (under the $100 protection minimum)
scenarios.workings: Rule 1 (saved_card): apple-card 0.90; wf-active-cash 1.80; FU 1.5% x 90.00 = 1.35. cashBest = AC. Rule 3: 90.00 < PROTECTION_MIN_ITEM_USD 100 -> the item doesn't qualify (FU's protections are eligible but there's no qualifying item). Rules 4-5: nothing. Rule 6: gain 0.90 < 5. Rule 8 -> keep / below_threshold. deltaVsCashBest = 0.90 - 1.80 = -0.90; deltaVsDefault = 0.00.

scenarios.title: Gift card $100 only
scenarios.workings: Rule 1 (saved_card): apple-card 1.00; wf-active-cash 2.00; FU 1.50. cashBest = AC. Rule 3: isGiftCard -> no protection is eligible, and gift_card is not a relevant category, so the $100.00 item doesn't qualify even though it meets the $100 minimum. Rule 6: gain 1.00 < 5. Rule 8 -> keep / below_threshold. deltaVsCashBest = 1.00 - 2.00 = -1.00; deltaVsDefault = 0.00.

scenarios.title: Social feed: text with no total
scenarios.workings: Rule 0: screenType not_checkout -> no_checkout / not_checkout. No cash, no card. (On device this page fails the checkout gate and nothing is sent; this tests the backend path.)

scenarios.title: Blurry screen: garbage OCR
scenarios.workings: Rule 0: screenType unreadable -> no_checkout / unreadable. No cash, no card.

scenarios.title: Order confirmation (already paid)
scenarios.workings: Rule 0: screenType order_confirmation -> no_checkout / already_paid. No cash, no card.

scenarios.title: Laptop $1,499, Discover default + Freedom
scenarios.workings: Rule 1 (saved_card): discover 1% x 1499.00 = 14.99; FU 22.485 -> 22.49. cashBest = FU. Rule 3: laptop qualifies; FU has PP + EW; discover none. Rule 4 (P) -> switch / protection -> FU. The pick is also cash-best: deltaVsCashBest = 0.00 ('Also earns the most cash back here'); deltaVsDefault = 22.49 - 14.99 = +7.50.

scenarios.title: Earbuds $249, Apple Card default + Freedom Rise
scenarios.workings: Rule 1 (saved_card): apple-card 2.49; chase-freedom-rise 1.5% x 249.00 = 3.735 -> 3.74. cashBest = Freedom Rise. Rule 3: earbuds qualify; Rise has PP + EW (same guide as FU). Rule 4 (P) -> switch / protection -> chase-freedom-rise; also cash-best: deltaVsCashBest = 0.00; deltaVsDefault = 3.74 - 2.49 = +1.25.

scenarios.title: Laptop, items unreadable, total readable
scenarios.workings: Rule 0: checkout. Rule 1 (saved_card, on totalUsd 1499.00): apple-card 14.99; AC 29.98; FU 22.49; cashBest = AC. Rule 2: confidence.items 0.45 < ITEM_CONFIDENCE_MIN 0.8 -> keep / items_unreadable, no protection switch and no cash switch (without rule 2, rule P would pick FU and rule C AC). deltaVsCashBest = 14.99 - 29.98 = -14.99; deltaVsDefault = 0.00.

scenarios.title: Walgreens $40, Apple Pay visible
scenarios.workings: Rule 1: Apple Pay button -> path apple_pay. apple-card: merchant rule walgreens + apple_pay 3% x 40.00 = 1.20; wf-active-cash 2% = 0.80; FU: category rule pharmacy 3% (cfu-drugstores, any method) = 1.20 (1.5% = 0.60 without that rule). Tie 1.20 / 1.20 -> the default: cashBest = apple-card. Rule 3: pharmacy not relevant. Rules 4-6: nothing. Rule 7 (M): Apple Pay 1.20 > typed 1% = 0.40, button visible -> keep / method. Deltas 0.00 / 0.00. Same answer with or without FU's pharmacy rule.

scenarios.title: Amazon $38 household, saved card
scenarios.workings: Rule 1 (saved_card): apple-card 0.38; wf-active-cash 0.76; FU 1.5% x 38.00 = 0.57. cashBest = AC. Rule 3: home not relevant, 38.00 < 100. Rule 6: gain 0.38 < 5. Rule 7: no Apple Pay button. Rule 8 -> keep / below_threshold. deltaVsCashBest = 0.38 - 0.76 = -0.38; deltaVsDefault = 0.00.

scenarios.title: Laptop $1,200, Freedom Rise default + Active Cash
scenarios.workings: Rule 1 (saved_card): chase-freedom-rise 1.5% x 1200.00 = 18.00; wf-active-cash 2% = 24.00. cashBest = AC. Rule 3: laptop qualifies; default Rise has PP + EW; AC none. Rule 4 (P): nothing Rise lacks. Rule 5 (G): default has purchase_protection that cashBest AC lacks -> keep / already_protected. Without the guard, rule C would switch: gain 24.00 - 18.00 = 6.00 >= 5. deltaVsCashBest = 18.00 - 24.00 = -6.00; deltaVsDefault = 0.00.

scenarios.title: Laptop $1,499 with Freedom default, Apple Pay visible, Mastercard (Apple Card) selected
scenarios.workings: Rule 1: Apple Pay button -> path apple_pay. FU 1.5% (any) = 22.49; wf-active-cash 2% (any) = 29.98; apple-card Apple Pay 2% x 1499.00 = 29.98. Baseline (v2.3): the selected saved Mastercard is apple-card (the only Mastercard in fu-default), so the AC / Apple Card tie at 29.98 goes to the baseline: cashBest = apple-card. Rule 3: laptop qualifies; FU's PP + EW are eligible on this path (Apple Pay charges the FU card). Rule 4 (P): FU adds both types apple-card lacks -> switch / protection -> FU ('In Apple Pay, swipe to this card'). deltaVsCashBest = 22.49 - 29.98 = -7.49; deltaVsDefault = 0.00. Before v2.3: keep / already_protected with Apple Card selected. Synthetic cart at Best Buy (acceptsApplePay unknown in data/cards.json), not Northbay: Northbay has no Apple Pay button in v1 (acceptsApplePay false, verified). Best Buy has no earn rule on any card and the same category (electronics), so the numbers are the same as at Northbay.

scenarios.title: S1-K guard: laptop $1,499, Freedom default, Visa selected
scenarios.workings: Baseline: a saved Visa is selected, and fu-default has two Visa cards (FU, wf-active-cash), so the screen doesn't say which: the baseline is the default, FU. Rule 1 (saved_card): FU 1.5% x 1499.00 = 22.485 -> 22.49; wf-active-cash 29.98; apple-card 14.99. cashBest = wf-active-cash. Rule 3: laptop qualifies; FU has PP + EW eligible. Rule 4 (P): no card has a type FU lacks. Rule 5 (G): FU has purchase_protection (and extended_warranty) that cashBest wf-active-cash lacks -> keep / already_protected (snippet). Rule C (+7.49 >= 5) never runs. deltaVsCashBest = 22.49 - 29.98 = -7.49; deltaVsDefault = 0.00. Scenario 5's guard case before v2.3.

scenarios.title: Renewed laptop $1,099, Active Cash default, Mastercard (Apple Card) selected
scenarios.workings: Baseline: the selected saved Mastercard is apple-card (the only Mastercard in ac-apple), not the default. Rule 1 (saved_card): wf-active-cash 2% x 1099.00 = 21.98; apple-card 1% x 1099.00 = 10.99. cashBest = wf-active-cash. Rule 3: renewed is not in any counted protection's conditionsAllowed. Rules 4-5: nothing. Rule 6 (C): gain over the baseline 21.98 - 10.99 = 10.99 >= 5 -> switch / cash -> wf-active-cash, the default ('$10.99 more cash back than Apple Card', 'Change card to Visa ••4321'). No eligibility note: no wallet card has a counted protection the condition blocks. deltaVsCashBest = 0.00; deltaVsDefault = 0.00 (AC is the default). Before v2.3: keep / default_best, while the order as shown earned $10.99 less.

scenarios.title: Jacket $1,200 (apparel), Freedom default, Visa selected
scenarios.workings: Baseline: Visa selected, two Visa cards -> the default, FU. Rule 1 (saved_card): FU 1.5% x 1200.00 = 18.00; wf-active-cash 2% = 24.00; apple-card 1% = 12.00. cashBest = wf-active-cash. Rule 3: apparel isn't theftDamageRelevant, so the jacket doesn't qualify for Rule P, but FU's purchase protection covers it (new, apparel not in excludedCategories; extended warranty needs a warrantyRelevant category). Rules 4-5: nothing on a qualifying item. Rule 6 (C): gain 24.00 - 18.00 = 6.00 >= 5, but wf-active-cash lacks the purchase protection FU covers on the jacket -> keep / already_protected (v2.3: a cash switch never drops cover). deltaVsCashBest = 18.00 - 24.00 = -6.00; deltaVsDefault = 0.00. Before v2.3: switch / cash -> AC with protectionsLost [].

scenarios.title: Sofa $1,500 (home), Freedom Rise default + Active Cash, Visa selected
scenarios.workings: Baseline: Visa selected, and both rise-ac cards are Visa -> the default, Rise. Rule 1 (saved_card): Rise 1.5% x 1500.00 = 22.50; wf-active-cash 2% = 30.00. cashBest = wf-active-cash. Rule 3: home isn't theftDamageRelevant (no Rule P), but Rise's purchase protection covers the sofa (new, home not excluded). Rules 4-5: nothing on a qualifying item. Rule 6 (C): gain 30.00 - 22.50 = 7.50 >= 5, but AC lacks the purchase protection Rise covers -> keep / already_protected. deltaVsCashBest = -7.50; deltaVsDefault = 0.00. Before v2.3: switch / cash -> AC, +$7.50, protectionsLost [].

scenarios.title: Groceries $1,200 at an unknown store, Freedom default, Visa selected
scenarios.workings: Baseline: Visa selected, two Visa cards -> the default, FU. Rule 1 (saved_card): the store is unknown, so no category rule counts; FU has no grocery rule anyway, so its 1.5% stays verified: 18.00; wf-active-cash 24.00; apple-card 12.00. cashBest = wf-active-cash. Rule 3: grocery is in excludedCategories for both of FU's protections (perishables, consumables), so FU covers nothing. Rule 6 (C): gain 24.00 - 18.00 = 6.00 >= 5 and no cover is dropped -> switch / cash -> AC. deltaVsCashBest = 0.00; deltaVsDefault = +6.00. Same answer as before v2.3; checks that the never-drop-cover rule leaves excluded categories alone.

scenarios.title: DoorDash $249 dining, Discover default + Freedom, Apple Pay visible
scenarios.workings: Rule 1: Apple Pay button -> path apple_pay. Discover: its Q4 2026 dining rule (5%) needs activation, so it isn't counted: base 1% x 249.00 = 2.49, marked partial. FU: DoorDash's catalog category is dining -> cfu-dining 3% (any) = 7.47. cashBest = FU. Rule 3: dining is excluded, nothing qualifies. Rules 4-5: nothing. Rule 6 (C): gain 7.47 - 2.49 = 4.98 >= 3 (apple_pay) -> switch / cash -> FU. Discover's rate is partial, so confidence is medium and line 2 says 'Likely more cash back than Discover' (§8.2). deltaVsCashBest = 0.00; deltaVsDefault = +4.98.
